_about: What the replica must match. 'published' comes from figure.ai/figure (read 2026-10-31); 'photo' values were measured with tools/compare.py on Figure 03 reveal-video frames (side 0:21.5, 3/4 0:24.5; widths from the front frame at 1:50 scaled by the head), heights scaled to the published height. Metres above the floor, standing straight. Iteration 2: the first estimates (low-res frames) had the head 4 cm too tall and the arm 4-8 cm too low.

look.head: glossy black egg, taller than wide, no visible face features
look.body: light grey knit fabric over torso, neck, upper arms, forearms, thighs, shanks
look.accent: short purple light bar at the sternum, 'F.03' chest mark
